name: graphide
description: Review agent changes as flow graphs — explorer workspaces over a closed IR, not a force-directed hairball.

graphide.cliPath.description: Optional override. Empty = ~/.graphide/graphide(.exe), then the extension bin/, then workspace target/. Building the CLI belongs in the Graphide source repo, never in the folder under review.

graphide.packageRoot.description: Folder to review (e.g. SolarSim). Empty = the open workspace folder. Not the Graphide source tree unless you are reviewing Graphide itself.

graphide.parentRoot.description: Parent revision root for coverage. Empty = git HEAD^ when the folder is a repo.

graphide.promptFlows.description: Default --flow prompts (name=hit,hit). The Review input can override these.

graphide.llm.baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible host. Local Ollama is http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1, LM Studio http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1, llama.cpp http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1, OpenAI https://api.openai.com/v1.

graphide.llm.model.description: Model name on that host (e.g. llama3.2, gpt-4o-mini). Empty = Ask answers from the derived graph only.

graphide.llm.apiKey.description: Optional. Prefer Graphide: Connect LLM (Secret Storage). Empty is fine for most local hosts.

graphide.bridge.enabled.description: Listen on a local port so any LLM client can query this review with the bridge API key.

graphide.bridge.host.description: Bridge bind address. Keep 127.0.0.1 unless you intend LAN access.

graphide.bridge.port.description: Bridge port. If busy, Graphide tries the next free port.

scripts.package: node ./scripts/bundle-cli.js && npm run compile && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository
